name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Route 1 - Happy Path)
trigger: Inbound SOAP request with Sales Order payload meeting {{Glovia_Route_SalesOrder}} condition
expected_outcome: Message routes to CallActivity_102 (Message Mapping 1), sets generic headers via Interface_Generic_Headers.groovy, and completes at EndEvent_2 with HTTP 202/200
validates: Message mapping transformation, header enrichment (Region, Country, BusinessObject, Sender, TimeStamp), and successful completion through Sales Order branch

name: Sales Order Return Processing (Route 2 - Happy Path)
trigger: Inbound SOAP request with Return Order payload meeting {{Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder}} condition
expected_outcome: Message routes to CallActivity_71 (Call Headers), executes Interface_Generic_Headers.groovy, and terminates at EndEvent_9
validates: ExclusiveGateway routing to SequenceFlow_113, header propagation into messageLog, and delivery to SO Returns receiver channel

name: Router Condition Not Met - Escalation End Event
trigger: Inbound SOAP request with payload that does not satisfy Route 1 or Route 2 conditions
expected_outcome: Router directs message to SequenceFlow_110 (default route), terminating at EndEvent_11 with EscalationCode RoutingConditionNotMet
validates: Default gateway branch execution, escalation event triggering, and prevention of silent message discard

name: Exception Handling and Original Payload Logging
trigger: Inbound SOAP request triggering an unhandled exception in processing (e.g., mapping failure)
expected_outcome: SubProcess_91 is invoked: CallActivity_97 restores ${property.InputPayload}, CallActivity_100 logs original payload via Log_Payload.gsh attachment, terminating at EndEvent_95 (Error End)
validates: ErrorEventSubProcessTemplate triggering, property InputPayload retention, attachment logging in messageLog, and final error state

name: Malformed SOAP XML Inbound Rejection
trigger: Inbound HTTP POST containing structurally invalid or malformed XML to SOAP adapter endpoint
expected_outcome: SOAP listener rejects request immediately with SOAP 1.1 Fault containing unqualified faultcode and faultstring
validates: SOAP adapter XML schema validation, SOAP Fault generation, and rejection before IntegrationProcess invocation

name: Boundary Test - Missing or Null Parameterized Headers
trigger: Inbound valid SOAP payload when externalized parameter headers (Region, Country) evaluate to empty/null
expected_outcome: Flow executes successfully without NullPointerException in Interface_Generic_Headers.groovy, logging only non-null custom header properties
validates: Null-safe handling in custom Groovy script and property enricher resilience
